note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are original writing for this entry; each cites the sources its facts come from. Hidden flags follow the PSN list as reported by PSNProfiles/Exophase via the cited guides (28 hidden, 27 visible). Counts are only given where a cited guide verifies them.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC, and there are no difficulty settings to worry about, so one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, with the 100% completion gold (A Long Road) doing most of the heavy lifting. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side strands, collectibles, and the activity grind last — and this unlocks on its own at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to its end and it pops. It is the opening mission, so every player earns it within the first stretch of the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and it pops as the chapter closes (PowerPyx notes chapter trophies can pop on the first mission of the next chapter instead of the last cutscene, so keep playing if it does not fire at once). Before the chapter ends, do the one thing Chapter 1 can take away from you: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — see that trophy's guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 2's main missions to the end; it pops as the chapter closes, or on the first mission of Chapter 3. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call your partner along, which most of the partner trophies need.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3's main missions; it pops as the chapter closes or on the first missions of Chapter 4 (PowerPyx notes it lands after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life). Chapter 3 is also where several systems unlock — jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun, the Key Cloner, and the Dye Pack Jammer — so do the side strands it opens while you are here.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play Chapter 4 through to its final main mission, Starting From Zero; the trophy pops when that mission ends. Chapter 4 also unlocks the bank-vault robberies through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which feeds three more trophies, so take that mission when it appears on the map.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the second gold in the set. Play the story to its final mission and finish it — the trophy pops at the credits. Guides differ slightly on how the finale is chaptered (PowerPyx ties it to the end of Chapter 4's Starting From Zero; other lists describe a Chapter 5), but the requirement is the same either way: finish the story. Before the finale, keep a manual save from just before it, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It matters beyond itself: this is the mission after which you can switch between Jason and Lucia and bring your partner along, which unlocks the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and the two-character activities.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Just play the story mission through — no side objective, no special approach, and no way to miss it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends, like every story mission trophy in this list.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Nothing optional about it: complete the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — just play it through.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx places this mission in Chapter 5, after the Chapter 4 finale, so it comes late — keep playing the story and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the long grind behind the platinum. The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx stresses it is not a true 100%: it is closer to 60% of the game, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly required. The parts that do need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The headline numbers: any 100 optional missions, scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars, 300 stunts, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. Do optional missions as they appear and scan every new vehicle and animal you pass, and most of this fills in while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida — you can mix the four kinds however you like, so pick the easiest. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps (ramps), 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps (parachute). Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your coverage under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done — and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find them. You will be introduced to most of them by the story anyway, and working on the other trophies covers the rest, so this usually pops on its own.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 12 ranges and all 42 golds. Golds are not brutally hard, and range practice also levels up your Focus, which helps Gunslinger later. Work through the ranges one location at a time and use the in-game tracker to see which challenges still need gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total, but only one win per location is needed. PowerPyx links a guide to all 14 locations. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win, and remember a drone race win also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location only counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins on the same track. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations across Leonida. Use the map to find un-won races, pick the vehicle class you are most comfortable with, and work through them between story missions; wins also feed the race activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline. After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Go there, fish with him, and keep following the questline until you get to fish against him — then beat him in the challenge. It is a friendly contest, not a grind: one win against Cal is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one of the four in-game arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home — just interact with the controllers — and you can already do this in Chapter 1, though the TV is briefly unavailable during some story sections. Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines out in the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best and play it to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. All five of her quests stay available after the story: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). Complete the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton) he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive to the shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. There are 7 shipwrecks to clear in total; after each set he calls you back to his shop and marks more. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so this is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, and every quest stays available after the story. Complete all five of his jobs in order: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes. The last one unlocks the trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but not every side questline counts. PowerPyx confirms these count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand — Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, and his deliveries). Questlines with their own trophies — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie — do not count toward this one. All strands stay available after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have finished. One caution from Output Lag: Yago's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save first and race it the moment it appears rather than leaving it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the Zorrusso from that mission plus 15 more (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D). Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars for you, and you can also steal them off the street — scan a high-end car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is wanted, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. It all stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is only available as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs). Complete that and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2 at the same location, so always bring your partner — you cannot finish the last spots until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE — the only trophy PowerPyx flags as potentially missable: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is gone once the chapter ends. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and she teaches you how. It is not yet confirmed whether that balcony meditation is actually required for the trophy — it raises the counter but is not marked as a regular spot — but PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so do it to be safe and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 spots are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do it, and he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation; a clean one-shot kill keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, though it is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this strand feeds A Long Road too. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy, so work through Bret's quests in order. The strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 card set locations across Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: work through three sets of your choice, using the location guide to find each card, and the trophy pops when the third set is complete. You do not need all 18 sets — three is enough.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan the object you are looking at. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus tag spots — well over 100 in total, so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Just scan everything that glows as you travel: landmarks and curiosities while exploring, sculptures in the city, and vehicles too, since scanning feeds Whip It Good at the same time.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. View and track them under Progress > Challenges, where scrolling over a challenge shows a Completed checkmark. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% requirements, so leave this for late in the run and then pick the easiest remaining ones — there are 10 more challenges than the 100% checklist needs, so you can skip the hardest. The 100% checklist wants any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then break out of the red heat area on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves. The trophy pops when you drive out of the heat zone — not when you merely leave the flashing blue/red search area. PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars, so you may earn it without trying.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner called in (hold Right, press Triangle — available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), rob 3 shops in a row while the police are still chasing you the whole time. You must keep the flashing red/blue wanted level alive between shops; if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation). PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store, ideally break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and move fast. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop — if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going until it does.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle, and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive the vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy pops automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. First buff your focus — eat or drink, wash up at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow-motion window. Then line up 5 enemies, such as the guards at a gang operation, and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556 assault rifle; wear body armor so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang enemies. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it (or walk in through the terminal), climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, and get inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops — it is deliberately delayed, so keep flying. Save first: the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and the trophy pops once you are in it and fighting. The tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the southwest edge of the map in Mariana County, parked in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the southeast entrance, climb into a tank, and shoot at the soldiers until it unlocks. Save before you go in: the base is heavily guarded.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store silently. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and unlocks jewelry store robberies (green icons on the map in unfogged areas). Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun — it stays in your inventory, no need to equip it. Kicking the door sets off the alarm and fails the stealth, so always pick the Snap Gun prompt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe with it, loot up, and leave without anyone spotting you. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape — there are 8 large bank jobs in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and walks you through the first vault: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and the vault to open, then get in fast and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right). After that quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (finish his earlier quests first, including robbing 2 Payday Loans) and he marks vans with a purple icon; follow them to the bank. Every vault robbery triggers an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. Each vault pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: tailing the armored security van to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and the trophy pops once you escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You can also do it earlier in free roam: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests, and Yasmani is unlocked as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that still shows black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx links a guide to the best plane for unfogging the map quickly. Do this after the story, when you have free access to aircraft and the whole map — it pairs naturally with the stunt and vehicle-scanning grinds.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops while you work toward A Long Road. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and Output Lag agrees the five cryptic trophies have no confirmed trigger. The official description is the only lead: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The sensible place to try is the beachfront bars and restaurants along Ocean Beach — order a drink where you can sit with the ocean in view — and watch for community confirmations, which are coming in daily since launch. This guide will be updated when a method is verified; do not trust any walkthrough that claims a precise spot without a source.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — hack into the Banshee with it, then drive forward through the glass. The trophy pop is slightly delayed and fires after you drive further away down the street. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee, not any other car: it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, which is also one of the illegal gang operations. You first visit it during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, marked automatically. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation (you need them to blow the safe). Inside, grab the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the northeast corner, and the contents of the safe in the northeast hallway. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so you can go back and grab the rest later: this one is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check each character's Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). Raise it by working out: buy a gym membership at a fitness club — filter the map by Activities (dumbbell icon) to find clubs all over Vice City — and always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), because while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, doubling your progress. You can also work out at home after the story. Keep both characters training together until both bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count out of 500. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): every time you do something that shifts your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (clean objectives and robberies, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, which PowerPyx warns to avoid because cops become more aggressive. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this fills passively while you chase the other trophies; if it is still short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, but keep an eye on your profile while you do.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and other launch guides describe it only as a hidden second-chance event whose exact method is unverified. The description — second time's the charm — suggests succeeding at something on a retry, but no guide has pinned down the trigger. Treat any specific method you see online as unconfirmed until a sourced guide verifies it; this guide will be updated when one does.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: U7BUY — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and go alone — it is slightly random, not a guaranteed spawn. At the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, matching the description. No guide has verified the exact conditions yet (which vehicle, how many targets, whether it must be one kick), so treat the motorcycle-kick theory as the best current lead, not a confirmed method. Try kicking an enemy from a moving bike and watch for the pop; this guide will be updated when a sourced method is verified.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: U7BUY — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements Guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — the total is cumulative, you never need to carry $250,000 at once. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults are the big earner, paying up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, and the total builds naturally while you rob everything the 100% checklist needs.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative across every shop type, and it counts from the start of the game. The fastest way to burn through it is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. PowerPyx counts the shop types as 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Just play normally, buy the gear you need, and top up with a few big purchases if you are still short near the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. There are 12 garages in the game, but 4 are story-related — only the 8 you buy yourself count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3 and 4. Buy garages early too — each one adds parking space you need to register vehicles for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, from Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each vehicle needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), and registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
